source.method: Playwright read-only DOM inspection in isolated session
source.state: TVP homepage -> linked TVP VOD -> account login -> Kontynuuj poprzez e-mail; signup opened through Załóż konto bezpłatnie. Each credential field was clicked (no values entered), and the site removed readonly from that field. This specimen is the observed post-focus state, including visible empty-field errors; initial readonly state and focus activation are replayed separately. No CAPTCHA, terms or account submission.

fidelity.structure: observed form subtree; stable synthetic node attribute added only to attach recorded CSS
fidelity.styles: computed layout and visibility frozen per element
fidelity.behavior: Recorded initial readonly state and focus-removes-readonly activation replayed in Chromium. Post-focus validation CSS is retained in the static specimen; validation transitions and post-submit behavior are not replayed.
redactions: values, URLs, scripts, handlers, iframe content and SVG paths omitted
